The image is a 4 by 4 grid of sixteen separate square photographs, four rows and four columns, of equal size, edge to edge with no gutter, no border, no frame line, no caption, no numbering. The sixteen panels are identical in exposure, white balance, background tone, camera height and subject scale, as if shot in one session on one set and laid out afterwards.

Sharp focus front to back, material texture clearly visible, matte surfaces stay matte.
